test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: On mixing two classes A and B of students having average marks 50 and 80, respectively, the average marks obtained is 60. Find the respective ratio of the students in the classes A and B.
solution:
**Given**

Average marks of class A = 50

Average marks of class B = 80

Combined average marks = 60

**Solution:**

⇒ Ratio of students in classes A and B = (Average of B - Combined average) ∶ (Combined average - Average of A)

⇒ Ratio of students in classes A and B = (80 - 60) ∶ (60 - 50) = 20 ∶ 10 = 2 ∶ 1

**Hence, the ratio of the students in classes A and B is 2 ∶ 1.**
